detail.longDescription: I built a Telegram bot that crossposts to 5 platforms for $0 Write once, press one button — the post lands in my TG channel, Bluesky, Mastodon, VK and Dev.to. Stack: Python + aiogram, ~150 lines, zero paid APIs. X went pay-per-use this year, so it gets a pre-cut version with a one-click compose button instead of an API call. LinkedIn — same trick. Next: photos and a scheduler. Which platform would you add first? # buildinpublic # webdev
